§5Healing Bonus and Healing Reduction§7 - increases and decreases the amount of healing received, respectively. All bonuses are applied simultaneously. 
For example:  
If a player has a 60% healing bonus and a 40% healing reduction, the effective bonus would be 20%, resulting in a healing of 12 HP instead of 10.

§5Healing Debt§7 - prohibits healing until the debt is paid off. Each healing reduces the debt by a 1:1 ratio. 
For example: 
Player with 20 max HP has a Healing Debt of 10% of their max HP (so debt = 2). After healing for 4 HP, the player would only receive 2 HP.

§5Over Healing§7 - the amount of healing a player or creature receives when already at full HP. 
Note: vanilla health regeneration potion effect can't Over Heal and can't heal above 20 HP. 

§5Shield§7 - protects against damage less than the shield value and activates after absorption or amplification effects from other mods. 
For example: 
If a player has 10 Shields and receives 8 damage, player will take 0 damage and have 2 Shields remaining. 
If 12 damage is dealt, the player takes 2 damage, depleting the Shields.

§5Overshield§7 - provides complete protection against damage, even if the damage exceeds the overshield value. It activates before regular Shields. 
For example: 
Player with 80 overShields and 10 Shields takes 99999 damage, resulting in 0 damage taken and 0 overShields, but 10 Shields remaining. 
OverShields are also 90% more effective against magical and void damage.

§5Adaptive Damage§7 - damage that changes its damage type to the next in the list if it fails to penetrate the target.

§5Paragon Damage§7 - guaranteed damage that ignores evasion, absorption, damage negation, and Shields but does not bypass overShields. 

§5Damage Type§7 - refers to its characteristic, what it does, and the properties it possesses. 
For example:
Damage type damageHelmet deals additional damage to the helm, while bypassInvul penetrates through invulnerability seconds between hits, enchantments, effects, armor, etc. 
Some Vestiges feature mechanics that change the damage type, altering such characteristics of the inflicted damage.

§5Damage Kind§7 - is a set of characteristics with specific name.
